info.title: Surfboard mobile API
info.description: The calls the Surfboard mobile app makes. Generated from `lib/mobile/contract` in the API repository: do not edit by hand. Every success is `{ success: true, data }`; every failure is `{ success: false, error, code?, details? }`. Dates are ISO 8601 in UTC. Objects are open: a newer server may add a field, and an app must ignore what it does not know.

post.description:
Only records the verification: call `refresh` afterwards, because the token's claims change when a new one is issued. Also answers `{ verified: true }` for an account already verified, so a lost answer can be retried. Five tries per five minutes per account.

A signed-in surveyor (role USER). Allowed while the email is unverified.

get.description:
A lean row per plan: one `displayStatus`, no geometry, pillars or file links. Order is the chosen column, then the plan id, so a page never repeats or skips a plan. A `displayStatus` filter is worked out on the server, so a request over 5,000 plans is a 400 (narrow the search). Reads are not subscription-gated.

A signed-in surveyor (role USER). Held at the email verification gate while enforcement is on: an unverified account whose grace has ended gets 403 EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.

parameters.description: Whose plans: the caller's own (default) or those shared with the caller.

parameters.description: Plan number, title, facilitator, LGA, ward, LCDA, locality or pillar number; at most 100 characters. `%` and `_` act as wildcards.

parameters.name: facilitator
parameters.description: The whole value, ignoring capitals and surrounding spaces.

parameters.name: provisional
parameters.description: Whether provisional plan types are in the list; `exclude` matches the Stats Total plans figure.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: On the date printed on the survey plan, inclusive. `YYYY-MM-DD` is that whole day (UTC); a full date and time is used as given.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: As `dateFrom`; a plain date is the end of that day.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: The column to order by; plans with no survey date come last.

error.description: A sentence for a developer. The app words its own messages and does not show this.

code.description: A stable code (see the list of codes). Some older failures have none: use the status.

details.description: Extra facts for some codes (VALIDATION_ERROR, APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED).

refreshToken.description: Single use: each refresh returns a new one.

emailVerifiedVia.description: How the address was verified; null while it is not.

mustVerifyNow.description: Read from the access token: current only after a refresh.

verificationGraceEndsAt.description: When an account that predates enforcement is held at the gate; null otherwise.

verificationCodeSentAt.description: When a code the person can still enter was sent; null when none is live (never sent, used, expired or out of attempts) and for verified accounts and link platforms.

Outline.description: Longitude and latitude as stored, not corrected for display. For drawing only.

queried.description: Equals the total of the Queried list.

queries.description: Empty when nothing is queried, and always empty for a plan seen through a share.

hasRecordCopy.description: Whether a record copy exists. The link is never sent.

sharedCount.description: People the owner shared it with; 0 when seen through a share.

ownerName.description: Who shared it, for a plan seen through a share.

areaSqM.description: Square metres, worked out from the boundary; null if the boundary is unusable.

stageDecidedAt.description: When each review last acted (a query counts); null while pending.

files.description: The entry's place in this list is the `n` of the file route.

name.description: The website's name: the plan number with `/` as `_`, then the extension.

format.description: Lower-case extension; empty when the stored name has none.

viewable.description: PDF and common images. Drawings are not.

ref.description: The stored reference. The app never shows or logs it.

url.description: A signed address that works until `expiresAt`. Never store or show it.

total.description: Every live plan the caller has, drawn or not.

withoutOutline.description: Plans left out because their boundary cannot be drawn.

truncated.description: There are more plans than were read.

total.description: Plans in scope that are not provisional.

byStatus.description: One count for every status code, 0 included.

byMonth.description: Oldest first; months with no plan are left out.

activeBatches.description: Not affected by the date range.

ownerName.description: Who shared it, for a plan seen through a share.

VALIDATION_ERROR.meaning: A parameter or body field is missing or not valid. `details` names the fields.
VALIDATION_ERROR.appDoes: Shows its own message; for a list it asks the person to narrow the search.

UNAUTHENTICATED.meaning: No valid access token (missing, expired or for another platform).
UNAUTHENTICATED.appDoes: Refreshes once and repeats the call; a second 401 ends the session.

SESSION_INVALID.meaning: The refresh token is not valid, was already used, or its sign-in was revoked.
SESSION_INVALID.appDoes: Ends the session and returns to the sign-in screen.

FORBIDDEN.meaning: The signed-in role may not use this route.
FORBIDDEN.appDoes: Treats it as the end of the session (ADR-0002).

EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.meaning: Enforcement is on and this account must verify its email first.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.appDoes: Reloads the profile once, which opens the verification screen.

SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED.meaning: An action that needs an active subscription. Reads never return this.
SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED.appDoes: Explains that managing a subscription is on the website.

ACCOUNT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED.meaning: The account is not a surveyor, so it cannot use the app.
ACCOUNT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED.appDoes: Says the account type cannot sign in to the app.

ACCOUNT_INACTIVE.meaning: The account has been switched off.

NOT_FOUND.meaning: Unknown, deleted or someone else's record (these look the same on purpose).

REFRESH_CONFLICT.meaning: Two refreshes of the same token raced.

FILE_NOT_VIEWABLE.meaning: The file is a drawing or another format a phone cannot open.
FILE_NOT_VIEWABLE.appDoes: Says the file cannot be opened on a phone.

RATE_LIMITED.appDoes: Asks the person to wait, without a countdown the server did not promise.

APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.meaning: This build is below the minimum for its store. `details` is `{ platform, minimumVersion, storeUrl }`.
APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED.appDoes: Covers the app with the update screen. Never ends the session.

MOBILE_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.meaning: New sign-ins are paused (an emergency switch). Open sessions carry on.
MOBILE_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.appDoes: Says signing in is paused for a short while.

VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID.meaning: The code is not six digits.

VERIFICATION_CODE_INCORRECT.appDoes: Says it did not match and lets the person try again.

VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED.meaning: No live code: it lapsed after 10 minutes, was used, or was replaced.
VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED.appDoes: Offers to send a new one.

VERIFICATION_CODE_LOCKED.meaning: Five wrong tries on that code.
VERIFICATION_CODE_LOCKED.appDoes: Offers to send a new one.
